html:
Hanoi to Halong Bay private car from Vietlook Travel is a high-quality transfer service with a friendly driver. This is a door-to-door transfer service suitable for people who stay in Hanoi City and have a booking on a Halong Bay Cruise.

The Hanoi to Halong Bay distance is about 172km, and it takes about 2.5 hours to transfer by car/one-way. By booking our Hanoi private cars, you will be the boss, you can decide the pickup time, and have a comfortable, flexible private car with a strong A/C.

Moreover, after Halong Bay, you may want to continue your Vietnam journey with visits to other destinations. This is the case, we have some good Ha Long private car transfers and tours for you.

HANOI TO HALONG BAY BY PRIVATE CAR

Ha Long Bay is one of the most renowned tourist destinations in Vietnam. It is honored to be recognized by UNESCO as a World Natural Heritage site in 1994 and 2000. The bay is owned by over 1,600 large and small islands scattered across the water, creating a unique and magnificent landscape. Besides its breathtaking natural scenery, Ha Long Bay boasts a diverse and rich marine ecosystem.

Noi Bai Airport To Halong Bay Private Car

Following your flight number, landing time, and the number of people, our driver will wait for you at the Hanoi airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can easily recognize him.

After greetings and setting up your luggage, our driver will transfer you safely to Halong Bay Cruise Port (Tuan Chau Pier or Hon Gai Harbor).

Along the way from Hanoi to Halong Bay, our friendly driver will be happy to stop at some rest stops for you to take a break, and drink some coffee. Upon arrival at Halong Bay Cruise Port, our experienced driver will make sure you forget nothing in the car and say goodbye to you.

Hanoi To Halong Bay Private Car Transfer

If you stay at a hotel in Hanoi, please tell us your hotel name/address and your desired pickup time. Our travel experts will send a sedan, SUV, or minivan to pick you up on time.

The car will pick you up at the Hotel in Hanoi City Center on time. After greeting you, the driver will take you to the car and help you put your luggage. Then, the journey from Hanoi to Tuan Chau Harbour, Halong Bay begins.

On the road, visitors can ask the driver to stop at some beautiful place that you like. Here, you can rest, enjoy a cup of coffee, and take a photo of the memorial.

Upon arrival at Halong Bay, you can request us to drop you off at the Halong Bay Hotel or at Tuan Chau Pier/ Hon Gai Harbor. Vietlook Trave wishes you a great Halong Bay Cruise trip.

Travel Tips

  • To guarantee there is space for you, especially during important holidays and popular seasons, you should reserve a hotel or cruise in Ha Long Bay early.
  • A wide-brimmed hat and sunscreen are essential for your trip.
  • Remember to bring your identity documents and visa to finish the check-in process.
  • We advise you to leave early because it’s a long way from Hanoi to Halong Bay.
